text: I'm really sorry to message, I'm probably overthinking it. My stepson is 3 and his temp is 39.6. He's got dark skin so it's hard to see anything, but I checked his palms and the bottoms of his feet and there are little dark red dots there, and a couple inside his bottom lip too. I pressed a glass on the ones on his foot and they don't fade at all. The weird thing is he's roasting on the thermometer but his hands and feet are freezing cold and he's shivering under his blanket. His neck seems fine, he can look down at his toes no problem. And no fits or jerking or anything like that. Sorry again for bothering you
